selection: Epoch 0 is a separate frozen-H1 replay reference. Each experimental arm selects one actually trained epoch by 0.5 original Val ACC + 0.5 mean noisy Val ACC; tie original Val ACC. Joint Val-only early stop after at least 15 epochs and 10 consecutive epochs without either arm improving. Test only after selection. No Test threshold tuning.
scope: 0/1/2 target task, fixed recording-level Train/Val/Test arrays, auxiliary matched views generated from same-split source components only. Both arms share data, interface, initialization, update count and equal auxiliary-label loss mass; candidate substitutes interchange outputs for an ordinary factual repeat. The reader starts from exact H1 replay and H1 remains frozen.
